title: The Bicycle Safety Drill
question: 把今天“被测试 -> 信号出现 -> 及时反应 -> 安全刹车”的表达，放进 bicycle safety drill 场景：用 word bank 补完整 5 个空。
example_answer: I am being tested in a bicycle safety drill. At first, I ride slowly and begin to acquire confidence. My teacher says, 'As soon as I raise my hand, you must stop safely.' This time, it takes me too long to react, so I press the brake too late. Next time, I will watch carefully and react as soon as I see the signal.
